name: m1-fix-lifecycle
coordination:
- `m1-fix-fence` owns `src/profile/**`, `src/config/**`, `src/report/**`, `src/brief/**` and
  `src/util/env-policy.ts`. It makes `compileProfile` turn `gitCommonDir` into the denyWrite and deny rules.
  Pass the value; do not depend on what the profile does with it.
- `m1-fix-cli` owns `src/commands/**` except `wait.ts`, and `src/cli.ts`. If you change a registry or shepherd
  export that a command other than wait uses, keep the old signature working.
